name: AgentsRoom

runner.notes: Install the AgentsRoom desktop app (not the simulated browser demo), authenticate at least one guest coding CLI outside AgentsRoom, open only runs/<run-id>/worktree as a project folder, create an agent session, deliver prompt.md via the AgentsRoom composer (or into the guest CLI), then harness-verify. Record AgentsRoom version, guest harness/model, and interventions. Demo replies are simulated and must not be scored.

inclusion: Direct Class A multi-agent ADE cockpit: desktop control plane that spawns real guest coding CLIs in xterm.js PTY sessions with an app-owned composer, roles, backlog, review, and remote/mobile control—without replacing the guest agent loop.
runtime_model_notes: Official: AgentsRoom is not an agent harness; it spawns official guest CLIs and never replaces their agent loop. App-owned composer/stage injects into xterm.js PTY sessions (e.g. scratchpad bracketed paste).
pricing_model: Free tier for a limited number of projects with unlimited agents; Pro plan for unlimited projects (site states Free to start / Pro pricing; re-check download/account pages for current EUR amounts). BYOK: tokens billed by the guest provider, not resold by AgentsRoom.
public_stack_signals: Official site: multi-project multi-agent desktop IDE for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity CLI, OpenCode, Aider, Grok Build, Mistral Vibe, Kimi Code, and GitHub Copilot CLI.
llms.txt: harness-agnostic layer that spawns real local CLI processes; not itself a coding agent harness; no API proxy / no token resale (BYOK).
Each agent runs in an isolated xterm.js PTY session with full scrollback; optional git worktree isolation per agent.
App-owned input surfaces (composer, scratchpad with bracketed paste, message queue, voice, screenshots) feed the guest CLI PTY.
macOS, Windows, and Linux desktop packages; mobile companion with E2E-encrypted relay; download page reported v1.132.0 on 2026-08-11 review.

guest CLI spawn in xterm.js PTY without replacing agent loop
AgentsRoom composer / scratchpad / message queue injection into focused PTY
role library, agent teams, backlog-to-agent, scheduled tasks
side-by-side and per-agent diff review plus commit context
project memory MCP and AgentsRoom MCP surfaces
remote fleet, SSH remote agents, mobile companion steering
moat_hypotheses: visual multi-agent cockpit reduces operator overload vs bare tmux/iTerm fleets
own composer + notifications while keeping guest harness quality and BYO subscriptions
remote fleet and mobile companion extend control beyond a single desktop
role library, teams, and backlog make the product feel like a managed agent team

research.positioning: A visual multi-project, multi-agent desktop ADE that orchestrates the coding CLIs you already pay for—spawning each as a real local process in an xterm.js PTY—while an AgentsRoom-owned composer, status board, backlog, review, and mobile/remote surfaces steer the fleet without replacing the guest agent loop.

runtime: guest coding-agent CLI processes (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Antigravity, OpenCode, Aider, Grok Build, Mistral Vibe, Kimi Code)
frontend: multi-project sidebar with zones and role-colored agent cards
app-owned composer, scratchpad, message queue, voice, and attachment chrome
browser demo with simulated data (not for scoring)
backend: local process spawn of official CLIs (no product API proxy for model tokens per FAQ/llms)
end-to-end encrypted relay for remote fleet and mobile companion
optional AgentsRoom backend services for dictation/voice credits (product feature docs)
loopback MCP bridges exposing app surfaces to guest agents
packaging: desktop installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux
mobile companion apps (iOS/Android) via official feature claims
Chrome extension for backlog/ticket capture (site links)
data: real local project folders on the operator machine
per-agent session state, prompts library (.agentsroom/), skills, commands
project memory notes written via MCP tools
optional unlisted gist upload for commit conversation context
unknowns: Desktop framework internals beyond xterm.js/Electron mentions in feature docs are not fully published.
Exact free vs Pro numeric limits and prices should be re-checked on account/pricing UI at install time.
How completely each guest TUI input bar is occluded vs dual-input is UX detail, not fully specified as a contract.

infrastructure: Desktop app opens real folders on the local machine and spawns guest CLIs in the project directory like a normal terminal.
Each agent is an isolated xterm.js PTY session that can persist across project switches with scrollback.
Optional git worktree isolation per agent for parallel work on one repo.
Remote fleet links multiple machines over an E2E-encrypted relay; SSH/SSM can host agents on remote boxes.
Model traffic goes to the guest provider under the user's existing subscription/key (BYOK); AgentsRoom markets itself as not reselling tokens.

agent_support: GitHub Copilot CLI (standalone copilot agent, not gh copilot shell helper)
orchestration: multi-project multi-agent visual cockpit with live status and notifications
14+ built-in roles plus custom/community agents and system prompts
backlog board that spawns agents from tickets
agent teams / handoff workflows and agent morphing (role switch mid-session)
message queue and prompt library with linked prompts
mid-conversation provider switch with handoff summary (product claim)
workspace_isolation: optional git worktree isolation per agent
multi-account support for Claude/Codex with per-project or per-agent pins
review_shipping: AI commit messages from real diffs
remote_mobile: SSH and AWS SSM remote agent hosting
context_memory: project memory via MCP (memory_save/list/get) shared across harnesses
integrations: AgentsRoom MCP servers (backlog, terminal commands, prompt library, browser)
skills export formats for other tools (product claim)

install_surface: authenticated guest coding CLI for the chosen harness
parity_risks: Browser demo may simulate agent replies; never use for scoring.
Guest harness/model dominates single-task correctness (runtime_model guest-cli).
Composer-first UX may hide or compete with native CLI TUI input—record how prompts were delivered.
Remote/mobile/fleet features are outside the v0.1 five-task local suite.
Optional worktrees and multi-account layouts can confuse harness verify roots if mis-pointed.

hypotheses: Composer + status + notifications on top of real guest harnesses is stickier than pure terminal multiplexers.
Mobile/remote control differentiates from Mac-only or local-only ADE peers.
Role/backlog/teams packaging lowers the coordination tax of multi-agent fleets.
evidence: llms.txt explicitly defines AgentsRoom as not a harness and documents xterm.js PTY spawn of official CLIs.
Official site FAQ states real local CLI processes with live terminal stream and no API proxy.
Feature docs describe app-owned composer surfaces (scratchpad paste, voice, screenshots, queue) targeting the focused agent.
unknowns: Head-to-head orchestration quality vs Orca/Emdash/Conductor is unscored.
Closed-source internals limit independent stack verification.
Sustained pricing and free-tier limits should be re-checked before commercial claims.
